decisionsTitle: An optional consent to promotional materials from the club and its partners, behind the privacy notice
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-09-29 15:45:** «I need an extra check on the registration for participants to optionally receive promotional materials from us and from clients (this also has to be reflected in the GDPR notice)». The owner's «clients» are the club's partners and sponsors; the club's word is «parteneri». **Amends §143** (a second optional consent under the list tick), **§445** (a second consent beside the newsletter, separate from it), **§550** (the newsletter page gains a second fold, for the same readers) and **the notice template of §322–§324**.

**The box.** One optional box on the registration form, per person, under «Vreau să apar pe lista de participanți»: «Vreau să primesc materiale promoționale de la club și de la partenerii lui — opțional» / "I want to receive promotional materials from the club and its partners — optional", with the megaphone glyph and one helper sentence, «Poți renunța oricând din pagina înscrierii tale.» / "You can opt out any time from your registration page." It is never pre-ticked, never required, never folded (§59) and never blocking: consent is a clear affirmative act (art. 4(11), 7 GDPR). It is on every event, whether or not the event publishes a list.

**Stored with its moment.** `registrations.promo_consent` (boolean, NOT NULL, default false) and `registrations.promo_consent_at` (the moment of the tick, or of the last change through a switch), expand-only migration `0113_promo_consent`. The notice version a form's tick was given under is the row's existing `privacy_notice_version`; a later yes from the person's own page is given under the notice in force at `promo_consent_at` (the version windows on `/admin/legal` say which) — no third column.

**The gate (AGENTS.md §10.8, the §396 mechanism).** A new merge field, `{{promotionalMaterials}}`, is both the words and the switch: filled with the box's own label, quoted, from the catalogue the form reads (`registrations/promo-consent-words.ts`), and read by `describesPromotionalMaterials`. The form offers the box only while the privacy notice in force names it in every language (`cachedPromotionalMaterialsOffered`); `submitRegistration` keeps a tick only when the notice this registration records names it — so a `true` is always consent to a text that described it, and a value posted while the notice does not describe it is ignored, never refused. `/admin/tasks` carries an open, never blocking row `promoNotice` with the steps; `/admin/legal` says the same beside the socials' line (`legal.promoMissing`); the legal editor's token legend lists the field. No text in effect changes: production keeps its approved notice until the club approves a new version from the template, and until then no box is shown and nothing is kept.

**Who may give it.** Only the person. A staff «Înscriere nouă» and the desk never set it — the service ignores a posted value on a staff origin, and the staff form says «Materiale promoționale: nu» with the reason, while the notice describes it. On a family's sitting (§543) the address holder's own form keeps it, and a minor's form keeps it (the parent consents for the child, as for the list); another adult's does not (§421: `withoutAnotherAdultsConsents` and `withoutAnotherAdultsDetails` drop it). That adult gives it on their own declaration: the declaration page — each step of the family's wizard (§471) included — carries the same optional box, offered while the notice describes the materials and the registration has not said yes; a tick there is written in the signing transaction and ignored, never refused, when the notice does not describe it. A test registration is kept exactly like a real one (AGENTS.md §12.6) and listed nowhere.

**Withdrawal (art. 7(3)).** `registrations/promo-consent.ts`, the shape of `list-consent.ts`: one write — the row locked, `promo_consent` and `promo_consent_at` set, one audit row `registration.promo_consent_changed` carrying `to: true|false` and the door, never a name — and four doors: the manage page, per person (§547), and «Înscrierile mele» (§77), each with «Nu mai vreau materiale promoționale» / «Vreau materiale promoționale» and the state in words, the token read and never spent; the declaration page, a yes only; and an Administrator on the registration's page, a withdrawal only, for a person who wrote to the club («Retrage consimțământul» gains «Acordul pentru materiale promoționale»; the audit row names the actor and the reason). A yes is accepted only while the notice in force describes the materials; a no always — so the way out is shown whenever a registration says yes, even under a notice that no longer names the field, and «Înscrierile mele» lists a closed registration that still says yes — in words of its own, «Ai bifat materialele promoționale la această înscriere. Cât timp e închisă, clubul nu îți trimite nimic pentru ea; poți retrage acordul oricând.» (`Registrations.promo.closedYes`), since the newsletter's fold never lists a closed registration and «Primești…» would overstate it. The same answer twice writes nothing. An Administrator's withdrawal of the health note, the socials or the results together with the promotional materials is one transaction (`withdrawOptionalData`): whole or nothing.

**The per-person doors trust the inbox.** The manage page and «Înscrierile mele» accept «Vreau materiale promoționale» for any registration of the same participant — the address — including another adult registered on it (§389). That is the list switch's shape (§143, §547), and it is not the address holder consenting for that adult: the adult's own messages go to that inbox, their own manage link and their «Înscrierile mele» arrive there, and no door can tell the two people apart. What §421 refuses is the holder ticking for the adult on the *form*, which the adult never sees; these doors are the person's own switch, reached where their own mail arrives. The notice's «bifa o dă numai ea» describes that: the adult gives it on their declaration or from their own page.

**Two consents, two switches.** The newsletter (§445) and the promotional materials are separate: a newsletter unsubscribe does not touch `promo_consent`, and a withdrawal here does not touch the newsletter. The person's page says so in one sentence.

**The notice template** (both languages, section 5 «E-mailurile»; the twelve sections and their numbers, which the code and the guide cite, are kept): a paragraph naming `{{promotionalMaterials}}` — news and offers from the club and from its partners (sponsors, shops, the events' partners), sent by the club alone to the registration's address, the partners never receiving the address or any other data; consent, art. 6(1)(a) GDPR and art. 12 of Law 506/2004 (in English «Romanian Law no. 506/2004», as the section's other paragraphs say it); the box optional and unticked; given when registering, when signing the declaration or later from the registration's page; for another adult on the address, only that person; withdrawn any time from the registration's page, «Înscrierile mele» or by writing to <EMAIL DE CONTACT> (the English text: <CONTACT EMAIL>, so the English notice is never filled with the Romanian «sau» between two addresses), with no consequence for the registration; separate from the newsletter; the list seen only by the club's organizers and administrators, who may download it. Section 6's «Nu le vindem…» adds «nici partenerilor clubului». Section 7: «Acordul pentru materiale promoționale: până îl retragi, dar nu mai mult decât înscrierea.» The four placeholders are untouched (§29). The template's own header says what changed; `/admin/legal` sees the moved template by its hash (§532).

**The backoffice and the exports.** The registration's page: «Materiale promoționale: da, din <data> / nu» (shown while the notice describes the materials, or while the row says yes). The registrations CSV and spreadsheet end with «Promotional materials» — the moment of the yes, or empty — last, so no column moves. `/admin/newsletter` gains a second fold under «Abonați», «Participanți care au bifat materiale promoționale» (the `partners` glyph, closed by default, its line the count with `countForm`): name, address, event, the moment, newest first, at most 500 rows drawn and the whole list in its own «Descarcă CSV» (`GET /api/admin/newsletter/promo`, UTF-8 with a BOM, `csvCell`, the audit row `newsletter.promo_consenters_exported` with the row count only). Listed: a real registration whose address is proved and which still stands (waiting for its declaration, on the waiting list, offered, confirmed) — never an unproved address, a cancelled, expired or test one. The readers are §550's: the Organizer, the Administrator and the Superadministrator (`canSendNewsletter`), asserted in the page, the route and the read; a volunteer, the Redactor, Tehnic and a member get nothing. The guide says one sentence in the Organizer's and the Administrator's newsletter steps, and the GDPR request's withdrawal step names the new group.

**Refused.** A pre-ticked box, or one required to register (not a consent). A box shown before the notice describes it, or a tick kept under an older notice (§10.8). The address holder consenting for another adult (§421). Staff ticking it for a person. Folding it into the newsletter (two purposes, two answers — art. 7(2)). A third email-link door with its own token purpose (an enum migration for a door the manage page already is). A separate column for the notice version of a later yes (the version windows answer it). Giving the partners the list (the club sends; the notice says so).
changelogLine: - **«Vreau să primesc materiale promoționale de la club și de la partenerii lui»** — one optional, unticked box per person on the registration form (and on the declaration page), shown only once the club approves a privacy notice from the new template; switched off or on again from the registration's page and «Înscrierile mele»; «Materiale promoționale: da/nu» on the registration's page, a column in the export, and a second fold on «Newsletter» with its own CSV for the Organizer and the Administrator. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Given the registration form while the privacy notice in force names `{{promotionalMaterials}}` in every language, when it renders, then it shows under the public-list tick one optional, unticked, not required box «Vreau să primesc materiale promoționale de la club și de la partenerii lui» with a glyph and the sentence «Poți renunța oricând din pagina înscrierii tale.»; while the notice does not name it, no such box is shown (2026-09-29, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given a public submission with the box ticked, when the registration is inspected, then `promo_consent` is true with `promo_consent_at` the submission's moment only if the privacy notice the registration records names `{{promotionalMaterials}}`; a tick posted under a notice that does not name it, from a staff or desk entry, or for another adult on a family's address is not kept, a minor's is, and a test registration is kept exactly like a real one (2026-09-29, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given a declaration signed with the promotional-materials box ticked, including a step of the family's wizard, when the notice in force describes the materials, then the registration says yes with the signing moment and one audit row `registration.promo_consent_changed` (`to: true`, `via: DECLARATION`); when it does not, the tick is ignored and the signature goes on (2026-09-29, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given a registration that says yes to promotional materials, when the person presses «Nu mai vreau materiale promoționale» on the manage page or «Înscrierile mele», then `promo_consent` becomes false with the moment and one audit row carries `to: false` and the door; the same press twice writes nothing, the link is not spent, a stranger's registration id is refused as NOT_FOUND, and «Vreau materiale promoționale» is accepted only while the notice in force describes the materials (2026-09-29, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given a person subscribed to the newsletter who also said yes to promotional materials, when the newsletter subscription is removed, then `promo_consent` is unchanged; and when the promotional materials are withdrawn, the newsletter subscription is unchanged (2026-09-29, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given the platform's privacy-notice template, when it is read in either language, then section 5 names `{{promotionalMaterials}}` and says the purpose, that only the club sends and the partners never receive the address, the basis art. 6(1)(a), that the box is optional and unticked and how it is withdrawn; section 6 names the partners as receiving nothing and section 7 the retention; no approved text changes, and `/admin/tasks` carries the open row `promoNotice` until a notice naming the field takes effect (2026-09-29, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given registrations that said yes to promotional materials, when «Newsletter» → «Participanți care au bifat materiale promoționale» is opened or its «Descarcă CSV» downloaded, then it lists name, address, event and the moment of each real registration whose address is proved and which still stands — never a cancelled, expired, unproved or test one — and the registrations export ends with the column «Promotional materials» (2026-09-29, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given the promotional-materials list and its CSV, when they are asked for, then the Organizer, the Administrator and the Superadministrator read and download them, and a volunteer, the Redactor, Tehnic and a member are refused on the server; an Administrator withdraws a person's consent from the registration's page with a reason, an Organizer is refused, and no staff door can say yes for a person (2026-09-29, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

batchLine: an optional consent to promotional materials, behind the privacy notice
